title: Taigo
tagline: Taigo is the first AI-agent-based DeFi gateway designed for broad crypto adoption. By leveraging self-adaptive models, LLM memory, and real-time analytics, it empowers seamless DeFi interactions across major social platforms like Telegram, Twitter, and Discord.
description:
Taigo is a cutting-edge platform that combines advanced artificial intelligence with comprehensive cryptocurrency capabilities, offering a seamless experience for both novices and experienced users. Leveraging self-adaptive models and optimized LLMs, it effectively interprets user intent, while its LLM memory functionality enables continuous self-training and performance enhancements through a powerful data flywheel.
We are focusing on bring out the best of DeFi on Ethereum for this Agentic Ethereum Hackathon, specifically, our mission is to simply the interactions with EigenLayer. With Taigo, restaking with EigenLayer is easier than ever before, creating a hassle-free, conversation based restaking experience.
how_its_made: This project utilizes our self-built agent framework and integrates the OpenAI LLM API. We employ several advanced LLM techniques, including methods for handling complex operations and developing small, self-training LLM models. These approaches enable us to accurately process user requests for DeFi protocols.
